{{Top|leg}}
The '''Bantha series''' was a line of [[Skiff/Legends|cargo skiffs]] manufactured by [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian Industries]]. The Bantha series was the most popular line of skiffs on the market, and included the [[Bantha-II cargo skiff/Legends|Bantha-II cargo skiff]].<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref>
